Your tasks include vacuuming and mopping floors, cleaning tables, chairs and touchpoints, cleaning toilets and washrooms, emptying bins and restocking sanitary supplies. You will handle many tasks independently, but there is always room to work together and check in with colleagues. The pace is high and quality comes first, so you work carefully and efficiently. After your shift, you have the rest of the day free for yourself. 
What we offer - Gross hourly wage of €15.52 under the Cleaning Industry Collective Labour Agreement - Temporary part-time role for 15 hours per week - Fixed days off: Wednesday and Thursday - Work in a well-known store with great colleagues - A good start to your day, with time for yourself afterwards

What do we offer? - A gross monthly salary between €2.400 and €2.800 based on 40 hours, depending on your experience; - Working conditions in accordance with the collective labour agreement for the fruit and vegetable processing industry; - 25 holidays + 9.5 Adv days; - Annual bonus of 4.5%; - A good work-life balance with the possibility of working time-for-time; - A close and friendly team where you will quickly feel at home; - Training as a forklift driver if required. 
What will you do? - You ensure the supply of materials at the production line using a forklift truck. Think of raw materials such as pears and cherries, but also jars and lids; - You assist in converting the production line when changing to another format or product; - You ensure that everything is ready in the morning so that production can start promptly at 07:00; - At the end of the working day, you clean up everything and make sure the workplace is clean and ready for the next day; - Your work depends on the season and is therefore varied! 
What will you bring? - A completed MBO education or experience in the agri/food sector is a plus; - You are flexible: in spring and summer we regularly work in 2 shifts due to peak traffic; - You are fluent in Dutch, English or German - Polish is an advantage.
